findings.statement: First creation proceeds through exact Editorial value, confirmProjectName event, and Options for Editorial existence. Duplicate is tapped at t=102.85, its synthesized event is t=108.28, and app idle wait begins t=108.63. Idle and animation notifications time out t=168.75/168.76. The following projectNameInput query fails with snapshot RPC timeout at UITests/ProjectLibraryUITests.swift:80.
findings.implication: This is the second naming-presentation/automation boundary. Rename, switch, relaunch, archive, and restore later in this method were not reached.

findings.statement: The Duplicate menu action only assigns a fresh Naming value (UUID identity, kind duplicate, title, and short initial name). apply(.duplicate) is called only by ProjectNameEditor onSubmit. No second confirmProjectName tap occurs in the log.
findings.implication: Do not attribute this failure to duplicate file I/O, store locking, or the duplicate domain operation; none is reached by the failing interaction.

findings.statement: The editor sets focused=true in onAppear. The native bridge coalesces focus work on the main queue, checks window membership before becoming first responder, suppresses synchronized delegate echoes, and cancels pending work at identity replacement/invalidation. Successful submit sets focused=false before awaiting the parent operation; after success it calls dismiss() and immediately clears isSubmitting. The parent ProjectLibraryView stays open while the naming sheet is replaced.
findings.implication: Menu dismissal, child-sheet presentation, keyboard transition, and field disposal/focus completion are relevant trace boundaries. These observations do not prove a focus loop, stale field, or blocked app main thread.

findings.statement: The failing wait is the ordinary waitForExistence at line 80. waitUntilEnabled failure diagnostics and name-entry mismatch diagnostics do not wrap this line. Existing native field tests mount fields in a window or one hosting Form and cover configuration, focus, composition, reconfiguration, and invalidation, but do not exercise the app's consecutive create/save/dismiss/Menu/duplicate sheet transition.
findings.implication: Passing isolated field tests cannot establish the repeated-sheet transition. The exact existing UI workflow must pass after any supported correction.

findings.statement: The same XCTest query variable is built from app.textFields[projectNameInput], not a stored XCUIElementSnapshot. The keyboard introduction helper completed earlier, before exact Editorial entry. There is no helper invocation at the duplicate boundary and no recorded evidence that the typing introduction reappeared. The test reports failed matching snapshots rather than a simple element-not-found result.
findings.implication: Changing identifiers, recreating the query, replaying the keyboard helper, or raising the ten-second wait lacks supporting evidence. The query already consumed substantially longer because snapshot RPCs stalled.
